reference: Olkiluoto, Finland, crystalline bedrock (no published log for these boxes)

description.lithology: Foliated metamorphic rock, likely granitic to tonalitic gneiss / migmatite. Light grey to white with darker grey to blackish mottled / streaky banding. Medium-grained, inequigranular, with a strong foliation / gneissic fabric showing wavy to folded light and dark bands. The core is cylindrical with a red orientation line marked on the core.

anomalies.explanation: Top row right end shows broken / missing core with a dark, irregular fragment at the tray edge.
Multiple sub-vertical fractures are visible along the length of the core in all three rows.
